description: The 'user_activity_summary' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of user activities within a system, capturing essential details such as user identification, profile information, and activity metrics. This dataset is particularly useful for analyzing user engagement, system usage patterns, and identifying active versus inactive users. Key features include user identification through email and display names, user profile types, and group memberships. It also tracks user activity through timestamps, days since last activity, and URLs for user management. Additionally, the dataset includes performance metrics such as error rates, warning counts, and job statistics, which are crucial for system administrators to monitor and optimize system performance. The dataset's structure allows for detailed analysis of user behavior over time, making it valuable for user management, system optimization, and strategic planning. By examining this dataset, organizations can gain insights into user engagement levels, identify potential areas for improvement, and ensure efficient resource allocation.
shortDesc: User activity dataset with email, profile, and activity metrics.

columns.name: username
columns.comment: User's unique identifier, often an email.

columns.name: displayName
columns.comment: User's display name, may include email.

columns.name: userProfile
columns.comment: User's role or profile type in the system.

columns.name: groups
columns.comment: List of groups the user belongs to.

columns.name: sourceType
columns.comment: Origin of the user account, e.g., LOCAL.

columns.name: email
columns.comment: User's primary email address.

columns.name: enabled
columns.comment: Indicates if the user account is active.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the user account was created.

columns.name: days_since_last_activity_or_login
columns.comment: Days since user's last activity or login.

columns.name: user_url
columns.comment: URL for managing the user's account.

columns.name: creationDate
columns.comment: Date when the user account was created.

columns.name: most_recent_job_time
columns.comment: Date of the user's most recent job.

columns.name: days_since_last_job
columns.comment: Days since the user's last job.

columns.name: error_avg
columns.comment: Average error rate for the user.

columns.name: error_sum
columns.comment: Total number of errors for the user.

columns.name: warnings_count_avg
columns.comment: Average number of warnings for the user.

columns.name: num_jobs_and_scenarios
columns.comment: Total jobs and scenarios executed by the user.

columns.name: num_projects_committed_to
columns.comment: Number of projects the user has committed to.

columns.name: num_days_since_last_commit
columns.comment: Days since the user's last commit.

columns.name: all_time_commit_count
columns.comment: Total number of commits by the user.
